Monday Night Ride (Blue Ridge Parkway Viaduct loop)

Blowing Rock, NC · Road

Monday Night Ride (Blue Ridge Parkway Viaduct loop) is a road group ride in Blowing Rock, NC. It rolls every Monday at 5:30 pm from Blowing Rock public parking deck (top level).

How we know

Boone Bike & Touring's Local Rides page lists the Monday Night Ride at 5:30 pm from the Blowing Rock parking deck and says Parkway closures will force route edits 'throughout 2026'; Boone Area Cyclists' page lists a Monday 5:30 pm ride too. No dated upcoming ride is posted (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

For visitors

The shop calls this a common first group ride and has printable directions for people not on Strava. Blue Ridge Parkway closures mean route edits through 2026. Boone Area Cyclists list the same Monday 5:30 ride as the Monday Bistro Ride.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15–17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Monday Night Ride (Blue Ridge Parkway Viaduct loop) group ride

The classic Viaduct loop out of Blowing Rock, 30 miles with about 2,500 feet of climbing. Most riders climb US 221 and descend the Parkway back to town. The group regroups before the Parkway descent and again near the end. Parkway closures in 2026 change the usual route.
